quote: In 2015 COCO Captioning Challenge, submissions are evaluated by human judgments with five kinds of metrics: M1... M5... Flickr 8K provides Expert Annotation scores... PASCAL-50S uses AMT workers to choose which sentence is more similar to the reference.

submissions of the challenge are evaluated by human judgments with five kinds of metrics: M1, percentage of captions that are evaluated as better or equal to human caption; M2, percentage of captions that pass the Turing Test; M3, average correctness of the captions on a scale 1-5 (incorrect -correct); M4, the average amount of detail of the captions on a scale 1-5 (lack of details -very detailed); M5, percentage of captions that are similar to human description.
guideline: Human annotators rate captions using metrics M1–M5 (better/equal to human, Turing test, correctness, detail, similarity) and expert scores (1–4) or pairwise preference judgments.
